Canary CI diagnostique v2 (hors `course-order.yml`) : ne peut PAS faire échouer le rendu. Démarre Postgres via dooD côté hôte, puis distingue les chemins réseau `dind` (host-gateway) vs IP passerelle brute depuis IJava. Sorties = verdicts pour le design de la leçon 08.

## C1 — Démarrage Postgres + diagnostics réseau (bash, non-faillant)

```{bash}
set +e
rm -f /tmp/zz_diag.txt
echo "docker server: $(docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' 2>&1)"
docker rm -f zz-pg 2>/dev/null
docker run -d --label ebpro-render=true --name zz-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=zztest -e POSTGRES_DB=zzdb -p 5432:5432 postgres:17-alpine || echo RUNFAIL
ready=NO
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker exec zz-pg pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=YES; echo "READY=$i"; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
[ "$ready" = "NO" ] && echo "NOTREADY apres $i tentatives"
# --- diagnostics dans /tmp/zz_diag.txt (tout redirigé, jamais fatal) ---
{
  echo "=== docker ps ==="
  docker ps --filter name=zz-pg --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'
  echo "=== ports binding (docker inspect) ==="
  docker inspect -f '{{json .NetworkSettings.Ports}}' zz-pg 2>&1
  echo "=== getent hosts dind ==="
  getent hosts dind 2>&1
  echo "=== default route ==="
  ip route 2>&1 | grep default
  echo "=== tcp test dind:5432 ==="
  (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/dind/5432 && echo TCP-DIND-OPEN && exec 3>&-) 2>&1 || echo TCP-DIND-CLOSED
} > /tmp/zz_diag.txt 2>&1
GWIP=$(ip route 2>/dev/null | grep default | awk '{print $3}' | head -1)
DINDIP=$(getent hosts dind 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | head -1)
{
  echo "=== tcp test gateway:$GWIP:5432 ==="
  if [ -n "$GWIP" ] && [ "$GWIP" != "$DINDIP" ]; then
    (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$GWIP/5432 && echo TCP-GW-OPEN && exec 3>&-) 2>&1 || echo TCP-GW-CLOSED
  else
    echo "TCP-GW-SKIPPED (same as dind or no gw)"
  fi
} >> /tmp/zz_diag.txt 2>&1
# --- seed ---
docker exec zz-pg psql -U postgres -d zzdb -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zz_stop(id int primary key, name text, lat double precision); INSERT INTO zz_stop VALUES (1,'Pommier',43.125),(2,'Chene',43.130) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;" || echo SEEDFAIL
echo "----- /tmp/zz_diag.txt -----"
cat /tmp/zz_diag.txt
true
```

## C3 — H2 baseline + Postgres via dind (java, try/catch totaux)

```{java}
var report = new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:zz", "sa", "");
     var s = c.createStatement()) {
    s.execute("CREATE TABLE zz_stop(id int primary key, name varchar(64), lat double precision)");
    s.execute("INSERT INTO zz_stop VALUES (1,'Pommier',43.125),(2,'Chene',43.130)");
    try (var r = s.executeQuery("SELECT count(*) FROM zz_stop")) {
        r.next();
        report.add("H2 rows=" + r.getInt(1) + " OK");
    }
} catch (Throwable t) {
    report.add("H2 FAIL: " + t);
}
try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:postgresql://dind:5432/zzdb", "postgres", "zztest");
     var s = c.createStatement();
     var r = s.executeQuery("SELECT name, lat FROM zz_stop ORDER BY id")) {
    var sb = new StringBuilder("PG-DIND rows=");
    while (r.next()) sb.append(r.getString(1)).append("/").append(r.getDouble(2)).append(" ");
    report.add(sb.toString());
} catch (Throwable t) {
    report.add("PG-DIND FAIL: " + t);
}
for (var line : report) System.out.println(line);
try (var w = new java.io.FileWriter("/tmp/zz_java.txt", false)) {
    for (var line : report) { w.write(line); w.write("\n"); }
} catch (Throwable t) { System.out.println("WRITE-FILE FAIL: " + t); }
```

## C4 — Postgres via IP passerelle brute (java, try/catch total)

```{java}
String gwIp = null;
try {
    for (var line : java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of("/tmp/zz_diag.txt"))) {
        if (line.contains("default")) {
            for (var tok : line.trim().split("\\s+")) {
                if (tok.matches("\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+")) { gwIp = tok; break; }
            }
            if (gwIp != null) break;
        }
    }
} catch (Throwable t) { System.out.println("READ-DIAG FAIL: " + t); }
String verdict;
if (gwIp == null) {
    verdict = "PG-GW FAIL: no gateway ip found";
} else {
    try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:postgresql://" + gwIp + ":5432/zzdb", "postgres", "zztest");
         var s = c.createStatement();
         var r = s.executeQuery("SELECT name, lat FROM zz_stop ORDER BY id")) {
        var sb = new StringBuilder("PG-GW via " + gwIp + " rows=");
        while (r.next()) sb.append(r.getString(1)).append("/").append(r.getDouble(2)).append(" ");
        verdict = sb.toString();
    } catch (Throwable t) {
        verdict = "PG-GW via " + gwIp + " FAIL: " + t;
    }
}
System.out.println(verdict);
try (var w = new java.io.FileWriter("/tmp/zz_java.txt", true)) {
    w.write(verdict); w.write("\n");
} catch (Throwable t) { System.out.println("APPEND-FILE FAIL: " + t); }
```

docker stop zz-pg || true
echo "===JAVA-DIAG==="
cat /tmp/zz_java.txt || echo NOJAVAFILE
